title: Mishti Doi
description: Mishti Doi is a Bangladesh dish made with whole cow milk, plain yogurt, pistachio. This home-scale recipe assigns measured ingredients to the steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Simmer the liquid and flavorings uncovered for about 30 minutes until reduced and concentrated.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
When sweetened milk has cooled to warm (about 42°C), stir in live yogurt starter and incubate covered in clean jars until set; then refrigerate promptly.
Cool the prepared ingredients promptly, then refrigerate for about 150 minutes until properly chilled.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
